name: Kaka Palace Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Registered with J&K Tourism (No. 79/ADTG) and described in Gurez listings as the first hotel-and-restaurant in the valley. The dining hall sits on a lawn two minutes from the Kishanganga and is one of the only kitchens in Dawar that serves outside guests — JKTDC stayers walk over here for meals.
insider_tip: Phone Younis on +91 94190 41186 to confirm a meal table; the kitchen plans portions in advance because trout, vegetables and meat all come up the road from Bandipora and stocks run out by evening.
signature_address: Near TRC Gurez, Dawar, Bandipora, Jammu and Kashmir 193503

name: Log Hut Cafe
signature_dish: filter coffee with Habba Khatoon view
why_it_matters: Opened by the Indian Army on International Coffee Day, 24 August 2021, as the first coffee shop in Gurez Valley — a sociability project for local youth, now staffed by trained Gurezi locals. Sits on the road into Dawar with the Habba Khatoon massif filling the window. Anand Mahindra publicly called it a '10-star destination' after a viral video.
insider_tip: Pizza and momos sound out of place in a Dard-Shin valley but they're what the cafe was set up to teach the staff to make — order one with the coffee. Open only in the warmer months when Razdan Pass is clear (roughly May–October).
signature_address: Near Habba Khatoon viewpoint, Dawar, Gurez, Bandipora, Jammu and Kashmir 193503
